lines.t: Verse 1:
He wrote His law with holy fire,
On stone and in our hearts' desire.
No other gods before His throne,
YahuShua reigns in Him alone.
No idol carved by hand or mind,
No name in vain—we keep it kind.
Remember rest, the Sabbath day,
To stop, to breathe, to watch and pray.
Chorus:
We walk in the way of Yahushua,
Truth and life, the narrow door.
He fulfilled the Word of Torah,
Love and mercy at the core.
From Sinai’s law to Calvary’s tree,
He calls us now to live and be
A light that shines, a soul set free—
We walk in the Way.
Verse 2:
Honor father, honor mother,
Love your sister, love your brother.
Do not kill or steal or lie,
Let no lustful glance go by.
Do not covet, do not hate,
Forgive before it is too late.
For every word and every deed,
Reflects the faith that we believe.
Chorus:
We walk in the way of Yahushua,
Truth and life, the narrow door.
He fulfilled the Word of Torah,
Love and mercy at the core.
From Sinai’s law to Calvary’s tree,
He calls us now to live and be
A light that shines, a soul set free—
We walk in the Way.
Blessed are the meek and poor,
Those who hunger, thirst for more.
Turn the cheek and love your foes,
Pray in secret, let pride go.
Sell your wealth to feed the least,
Welcome strangers to your feast.
What you do for them you’ve done,
To Me—the Father's risen Son.
Verse 3 (Early Church Living):
They broke their bread from house to house,
With joy and awe, they lived it out.
One in heart and one in mind,
No one lacked, for love’s not blind.
They preached the truth in boldness still,
Healed the sick, obeyed His will.
Not just hearers, but they did,
As Yahushua taught and bid.
We walk in the way of Yahushua,
Truth and life, the narrow door.
He fulfilled the Word of Torah,
Love and mercy at the core.
From Sinai’s law to Calvary’s tree,
He calls us now to live and be
A holy bride, in unity—
We walk in the Way.
Outro (soft):
No turning back, no other name,
We walk in truth, we walk in flame.
From age to age, we still proclaim:
Yahushua lives—we walk His Way.
